decisions.reason: The margin analysis kept its own page in both years. That suggests sustained commitment and positive signals, and keeping it on a shared data platform costs little, so the option stays open.

It fell from its own page to a mere mention, which weakens the signal, but it draws on the firm's maintained tariff databases. Its uncertain value is still cheap to preserve while related tariff products were already pruned.

The area definition tool was downgraded to a mention, yet it likely supports the location-based analysis and tariff tools. The low marginal cost argues for keeping the option rather than abandoning it yet.
